queries.name: event_list_select_monitoring_events
queries.statement: f"SELECT a.run_id,m.sequence,m.body FROM monitoring_events m JOIN assignments a ON a.id=m.assignment_id WHERE a.run_id IN ({','.join('?' * len(runs))}) AND json_extract(m.body,'$.event') IN (?,?) ORDER BY m.sequence"

queries.name: event_list_select_experiments
queries.statement: f"SELECT id,snapshot FROM experiments WHERE id IN ({','.join('?' * len(runs))})"

queries.name: audit_select_audit
queries.statement: 'SELECT * FROM audit WHERE workspace_id=? ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 100'
